description: Preview a plain-language request without generating: image or video, shape, duration and the estimate. Free. Pass quality "best" when the user asked for it (the estimate is then the most it can cost, "up to X cents") and max_cost_cents when they gave a budget: the answer says whether it fits. Image and video only; several characters or over about 30 seconds is a film: use plan_film.

intent.description: What you want, in natural language, e.g. 'a 10s vertical clip of a sunrise for TikTok'

max_cost_cents.description: The user's budget for this one generation, in cents. Nothing is spent here: the plan says whether the estimate fits under it, and the same number goes to create as max_cost_cents.

quality.description: Set "best" only when the user asks for the best or highest quality: Corent then uses its top model for the job, which costs more. Leave it out otherwise and Corent picks the model.

name: plan
title: Plan (cost preview, no generation)
